title: Pinned search, timeline and observation disclosure contract

Recommends checking neighbouring corrections and filtering before hydration.
notes: Selected documentation fetched; token savings not replicated. Followed into MR-02 and its imported semantic strategy; generated observations are not original evidence.

title: Search strategy selection, errors and empty-category supplementation
claims: executeWithFallback uses SQLite without a semantic strategy, propagates configured semantic failures and supplements empty categories.
At the same pin, strategies/ChromaSearchStrategy.ts applies project filters, recency filtering and database hydration.
notes: Selected source methods fetched from upstream raw content. Code contradicts an older universal stripped-query fallback description. No installation, authorization or recall trial.

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
claims: Paper describes summary/recent-message extraction and four-operation update decisions, plus graph memory.
Sections 4.3-4.5 separate query latency, memory footprint and construction analysis; full context has a higher overall judge score in its comparison.
notes: Author-reported LoCoMo results, not independent replication. Followed into current Python source MR-04; paper algorithm and current implementation must not be conflated.

title: Additive extraction, explicit non-inference path and deletion/history methods
claims: _add_to_vector_store uses a phased additive extraction/embedding/persistence pipeline; infer=False directly stores eligible message content.
_delete_memory removes the vector and records previous content in history; entity cleanup is best effort; delete_all enumerates batches.
notes: Selected add/delete/helper paths inspected, not the whole SDK or hosted Platform. Followed delete into history and entity-cleanup calls. No TypeScript parity, graph implementation, purge or provider trial claimed. Discovery configuration: https://docs.mem0.ai/open-source/overview.

title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
claims: Combines passage/phrase graph, query-to-triple matching, recognition filtering and Personalized PageRank.
Appendix E diagnoses filtering and graph-ranking failures in 100 imperfect-recall cases; Appendix F specifies indexing hardware/provider conditions.
notes: Selected method, ablation, error and cost sections inspected. Conditional error sample is not the overall failure rate. Followed into MR-06. No coding-memory or desktop cost extrapolation.

title: Retrieval fallback and source-aware graph deletion
claims: retrieve falls back to dense passage retrieval when rerank_facts returns no facts.
delete updates persisted source mappings and shared graph contributions, removes unreferenced indexes and rejects legacy provenance-free graph deletion.
notes: Selected retrieve, rerank_facts, delete and _remove_fact_sources_from_graph methods inspected at this pin. Source mitigations do not establish crash atomicity, tenancy, temporal correction or backup erasure; n=0 runtime.

title: Temporal graph, model and operator requirements
claims: Documents temporal facts and hybrid graph/semantic/keyword retrieval.
Operator supplies services and owns tenancy/access control; structured-output requirements can be problematic for smaller models.
notes: Followed into temporal maintenance MR-08 and ingestion/search/removal MR-09. Supported database/runtime choices are deployment requirements, not installed-platform evidence.

title: Temporal invalidation, contradiction intervals and timestamp extraction
claims: _apply_temporal_invalidation and resolve_edge_contradictions compare dated validity intervals rather than ingestion order alone.
_extract_edge_timestamps can call an LLM and handles extraction failure; date comparison correctness depends on the extracted candidates/dates.
notes: Selected temporal and resolver paths inspected. Correctness dependence is an inference from call structure; not a measured failure rate or assertion about every provider.

title: Episode ingestion, scoped search parameters and deletion-derived summary rebuild
claims: add_episode accepts reference time/group identity; search_ exposes graph search configuration.
remove_episode preserves multiply supported facts and rebuilds surviving entity summaries; its rebuild failure path retains the previous summary.
notes: Selected method control flow fetched, including post-removal summary rebuild and exception path. Does not establish runtime retention compliance, external cache/backup behavior or authenticated tenant ownership.

title: Mnemopi lexical/local/remote roles and host bank scoping
claims: Documents SQLite memory, lexical recall, optional local ONNX and compatible model endpoints; no bundled GGUF generation model.
Banks belong to the library; project/global visibility belongs to the host wrapper.
notes: Followed exports into src/core/memory.ts and its beam/store.ts implementation (MR-11). Reuses the existing Pi foundation/runtime comparison; no installation or local model trial.

title: Working-memory deletion and interrupted embedding rebuild reconciliation
claims: Facade src/core/memory.ts forget delegates through BeamMemory to forgetWorking; that path removes the current-session working row transactionally, purges working artifacts and invalidates caches.
reconcileEmbeddingModel handles stamped model mismatches and re-enqueues missing embeddings after interrupted rebuild.
notes: Inspected facade at https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/0b5c27ab24719c86a5986b95ee55f4e75bc1aaa0/packages/mnemopi/src/core/memory.ts, beam/index.ts forwarding and selected store methods. No assertion that working deletion erases all consolidated descendants; no migration/recovery execution.
